verdict.rationale: Agent orders settle on standard Stripe objects: ACS orders arrive as checkout.session.completed with a PaymentIntent, and x402 payments are recorded as PaymentIntents. The machine-payments docs say refunds go through the standard Refunds API and Dashboard, and the MCP server can initiate refunds behind a human approval gate. Refunds for ACS checkout orders are only implied by these shared rails, not documented. missing for 10: explicit refund docs for ACS/ACP agent-placed checkout orders, refund status tracking or webhooks tied to agent orders, refund handling for the third-party-processor custom integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
